responsibility: Implements lowering of Rust associated items that live inside impls and traits into their HIR member forms. This file translates impl type aliases, associated constants, impl methods, trait methods, trait constants, and trait associated types by lowering generic parameters, where clauses, self parameters, function parameters, patterns, types, expressions, and optional bodies, then creating the appropriate HIR::ImplItem or HIR::TraitItem nodes and registering parent-child links, HirId/DefId mappings, self/parameter mappings, source locations, and outer attributes. It is the concrete implementation counterpart to the impl-item interface header and focuses specifically on member declarations inside impl/trait contexts rather than whole items or statements.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for the same-stem impl-item lowerer interface: it provides the visitor bodies and translation routines for both `ASTLowerImplItem` and `ASTLowerTraitItem`, constructing HIR impl/trait member nodes and registering mappings. The corresponding header only declares those lowering classes and entry points.
